newsitem.title: USA: Raines says FY97 US budget deficit below $50 bln.
newsitem.headline: Raines says FY97 US budget deficit below $50 bln.

text.p: White House budget director Franklin Raines confirmed Monday that the budget deficit for fiscal 1997, that ends September 30, would be below $50 billion.
"In 1992 the deficit was $290 billion and we've estimated this year it's going to be dropping below $50 billion this year," Raines said in a luncheon speech to the National Urban League.
White House chief of staff Erskine Bowles told reporters last week that the administration had brought the budget deficit below $50 billion.
